ZP-IV: National Vulnerability Database Program Manager: As the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) Program Manager, you will lead information security projects and technical teams with limited oversight to support NIST's cybersecurity mission.

Manage the NVD and its associated software infrastructure, overseeing project lifecycles and technical teams to ensure operational excellence. Interact with relevant stakeholder groups to anticipate and determine the needs of end users, planning and implementing new capabilities as required.

Support the ongoing development of global standards, including CVSS, CVE, and CPE, through active participation in international standards organizations. Identify deficiencies in the existing vulnerability management ecosystem to suggest and develop new capabilities and technical guidelines.

ZP-V: National Vulnerability Database Program Manager: As the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) Program Manager, you will provide expert leadership and strategic direction for the NVD portfolio and serve as a primary authority on vulnerability management standards.

Define program goals and exercise wide latitude to influence the national security posture and the broader vulnerability management portfolio. Coordinate with high-level stakeholders to identify complex end-user requirements and plan the integration of next-generation capabilities.

Influence and drive the development of standards (e.g., CVSS, CVE, CPE) through leadership roles and high-impact contributions within standards-developing organizations. Architect new NIST-developed guidelines and national-level capabilities by identifying and addressing critical gaps in the vulnerability management ecosystem.
Experience must be IT-related; the experience may be demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (for example, IT certification), as appropriate GS-5 through GS-15 (or equivalent): For all positions, individuals must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below.

The employing agency is responsible for identifying the specific proficiency level required for each competency at each grade level, based on the requirements of the position being filled. Attention to Detail- Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service- Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication- Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving- Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. In addition to the above requirements, Applicants must have one year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 level (ZP-III at NIST).

Specialized experience is defined as: Experience working with vulnerability management identifiers and specifications such as CVE, CVSS, CPE, and CWE. Experience with CPE, Product-URL, SBOM, SWID, or different mechanisms of representing or modeling vulnerability information. Experience working with or in standards development to produce standards.

For the ZP-V: In addition to the above basic requirements, all applicants must have one year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-14 level (ZP-IV at NIST). The specialized experience is defined as: Experience managing software projects.

Experience leading the implementation of vulnerability identifiers and specifications (e.g., CVE, CVSS, CPE, CWE). Experience leading and implementing the use of SBOM, CPE, SWID, Product-URL, or other vulnerability information modeling mechanisms based on a critical evaluation of their benefits and limitations.

Experience spearheading initiatives within standards development to produce and ratify new standards.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills, and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. The qualification requirements in this vacancy announcement are based on the U.S.

Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards Handbook. If requesting reconsideration of your qualification determination, please refer to the following site: Applicant Reconsideration

Serves as the Aquatics Program Manager responsible for the daily operation and supervision of aquatic fitness, training and recreational programs, personnel, and classes at aquatic facilities. Manages multiple indoors and outdoors pools.
Provides overall supervision of the aquatic programs. Establishes and reviews the Aquatic programs. Establishes and reviews the Aquatic Risk Management plan for all aquatic facilities.
Coordinates with the MWR marketing department to publicize aquatic events. Establishes and executes processes to evaluate the effectiveness of the aquatic programs. Responsible for APF and NAF budget for assigned facilities and programs.
Develops and updates the Standard Operating Procedures for the aquatic facilities, programs and enforces policies. Interviews and selects such staff and provides them with required orientation, training and management to meet all activity needs.

Resumes must be two pages (or less). Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position. A qualified candidate must possess the following: Possesses demonstrated experience in planning, administering and executing aquatic programs.

This experience may have been gained managing indoor or outdoor aquatic programs and facilities. Required experience must have been equivalent to the next lower grade level. An undergraduate or graduate degree in related fields such as physical education or kinesiology may be substituted for six (6) months of the required work experience.

If using education in place of experience, transcripts must be uploaded at the time of application.

Possesses and maintains the following certifications: -American Red Cross Lifeguarding and First Aid -CPR for the Professional Rescuer/AED -Lifeguard Instructor (Red Cross) -Water Safety Instructor (Red Cross) -Aquatic Facilities Operator (AFO) or Certified Pool Operator (COP) certification In addition, for facilities that use Oxygen Administration & 02 bottles; the Oxygen Administration & 02 Administration certification (Red Cross or installation offered training) must be obtained within two weeks of reporting for duty.

In addition to the above qualifications, candidates who possess the following qualifications will be considered "Highly Preferred" or "Best Qualified": -Lifeguard Instructor Trainer (Red Cross) -Water Safety Instructor (Red Cross) -Equipment (Safe Operations and Basic Maintenance Repairs) -Nationally Recognized Basic Fitness Trainer Certification or Aquatic Exercise Association Instructor -Adapted Aquatics Instructor -SCUBA Diving Instructor (PADI, NAUI, YMCA or equivalent) Applicants who meet the Minimum qualifications, & Highly Preferred Criteria will be referred to management for consideration first.

All others may be referred if management does not make a selection from the Highly Preferred list.

Why Thunderbird?
Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At MZLA, the team behind Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.
We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.
We are a small but growing company of 60+ people distributed across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, and new product experiences that help people and organizations work more effectively without giving up control to big tech ecosystems.
Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s apps freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.
A note about MZLA and Mozilla: MZLA Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird and part of the Mozilla family. MZLA is separate from Mozilla Corporation and has its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.
To learn more, visit www.thunderbird.net
The opportunity
Thunderbird is growing beyond our free desktop and mobile applications, and we’re looking for a Senior Privacy & Compliance Program Manager to help build and strengthen the privacy, compliance, data governance, and vendor review practices that support MZLA’s products and operations.
Privacy and compliance are central to how we build and maintain user trust, particularly for a global user base with a significant presence in Europe.

As MZLA expands its products and services, this role will help ensure that data is collected, used, shared, retained, and governed responsibly, in line with Thunderbird’s values and user trust commitments.

You will help translate privacy, security, and compliance requirements into practical processes that fit our products and services, infrastructure, support workflows, vendor ecosystem, and operating model.
MZLA is a small, growing organization, and the right person will be a hands-on program manager who can create structure without overcomplicating the work. You will work across legal, engineering, product, support, finance, operations, and other Mozilla-wide partners to clarify ownership, track open items, identify when issues need escalation, and keep cross-functional privacy and compliance work moving.
This role requires strong judgment, excellent follow-through, and the ability to operate across legal, technical, operational, and leadership contexts. You will help ensure privacy and compliance work is well coordinated, appropriately documented, and grounded in practical processes that support user trust and responsible product development.
This role requires regular overlap with Eastern Time working hours for meetings, collaboration, and time-sensitive coordination. We welcome candidates in other time zones who can consistently maintain meaningful overlap with ET.

Coordinate MZLA’s privacy and compliance program work, including planning, recurring reviews, risk tracking, documentation, and leadership reporting.
Translate privacy, security, and compliance requirements into practical processes that fit how MZLA works.
Coordinate vendor and tool reviews with legal, engineering, product, support, finance, operations, and other stakeholders.
Help document data flows, subprocessors, and privacy, security, contractual, and operational considerations.
Support privacy operations and data governance for a global user base, including DSAR and privacy-rights workflows.
Help develop and maintain practical data inventories, records of processing, retention practices, and privacy-related documentation.
Partner with technical teams to support privacy-by-design practices for new products, services, tools, and data-processing activities.
Support compliance and audit-readiness efforts, including ISO-related readiness, evidence tracking, access reviews, and remediation follow-up.
Help strengthen incident response readiness by clarifying roles, escalation paths, documentation expectations, and coordination needs.
Build lightweight guidance, checklists, templates, and training materials that help teams meet privacy and compliance expectations without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

8+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably within a software, SaaS, technology, or technical product environment.
5+ years of direct or closely related hands-on experience in privacy operations, compliance program management, GRC, legal operations, security compliance, vendor governance, data governance, or a similar function.
Experience coordinating cross-functional programs across legal, engineering, product, support, finance, and operations teams, including work with external counsel, advisors, auditors, consultants, or vendors to move complex work forward.
Experience supporting vendor, tool, or subprocessor reviews, including privacy, security, legal, and operational risk considerations.
Experience supporting privacy operations, data governance, or user-rights workflows for products or services with international users, including areas such as GDPR or EU privacy requirements, DSARs, deletion or export requests, data inventories, records of processing, retention, access controls, or privacy policy maintenance.
Technical fluency and the ability to work with technical teams to understand how data moves through systems, including cloud services, vendor tools, support systems, logs, telemetry, authentication, access permissions, and data storage.
Familiarity with incident response, breach readiness, or security/privacy escalation processes.
Strong project and program management skills, excellent written communication, sound judgment, and the ability to build pragmatic, right-sized processes for a small but growing organization.
Ability to learn, evaluate, and responsibly use emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to improve work processes.
Ability to operate with initiative in areas where processes are still evolving, including identifying stakeholders, proposing next steps, clarifying ownership, and knowing when to escalate.

Experience supporting ISO 27001 readiness, SOC 2 readiness, audits, certifications, or similar compliance efforts.
Experience working in an open-source, consumer software, communications, email, privacy-focused, or mission-driven technology organization.
Experience developing training or enablement materials for privacy, security, compliance, vendor review, or data handling.
Experience with GRC platforms, policy management tools, ticketing systems, vendor management tools, or other systems used to track compliance workflows.
Privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, or similar.

About Welo Data Welo Data, a Welo Global brand, is the multilingual data and evaluation partner for foundation labs and enterprises deploying GenAI systems globally.

They deliver the human judgment, data infrastructure, and evaluation systems that ensure AI models perform reliably across languages, cultures, and real-world contexts, at every stage from training through deployment.

Its global network of 500,000+ vetted experts spans 300+ languages and locales, enabling high-quality multilingual data creation and structured model evaluation across the full spectrum of modern AI applications — from large language models and voice and speech systems to agentic workflows and robotics and embodied AI.

This breadth of linguistic, cultural, and domain expertise enables Welo Data to address critical AI development challenges, including safety, bias, inclusivity, and cross-lingual reliability.

A unified global operating model, led by specialized program and quality experts and grounded in assessment-driven talent selection, localized rubrics, and continuous calibration, ensures consistent performance across languages, domains, and modalities.

Underpinning all of this is NIMO™ (Network Identity Management and Operations), Welo Data's proprietary identity and fraud-prevention framework.

Built to maintain data integrity and workforce trust across a global contributor base, NIMO combines advanced verification, continuous monitoring, and structured QA to ensure every dataset is accurate, traceable, and culturally grounded. welodata.ai   The Senior Project Manager oversees a portfolio of Data Collection (DC) projects across onsite, studio, and remote modalities.

Leads delivery and scale: contributor capacity planning, vendor management, and process improvement. Ensures quality is consistent across projects, drives performance improvements, and plans work jointly with the Quality team. Ensures financial performance and compliance requirements are met across all DC projects in the portfolio.

Job Reference: Main responsibilities
DC function build-out: Support the Senior Manager DC in building operational capability - contribute to SOP development, tool evaluation, process design, and piloting new collection modalities as the function scales.
Portfolio delivery: Plan and run a portfolio of DC projects (onsite, studio, remote) end-to-end; set priorities, milestones, and handoffs across time zones.
Governance & reporting: Maintain DC portfolio tracker and dashboard; run regular delivery reviews covering project status, contributor pipeline, and quality outcomes (status, risk, escalations); flag risks and escalations to Senior Manager DC with clear options and impact.
Capacity planning: Forecast and secure contributor capacity across modalities, locales, and project types for the portfolio; flag capacity risks and cross-programme conflicts.
Quality consistency: Partner with the Quality team on acceptance criteria, QC rubrics, audits, and corrective actions; ensure quality standards are applied consistently across projects and modalities.
Process improvement & tooling: Identify manual or inefficient steps in DC workflows; own SOP maintenance; drive adoption of DC tooling across the team.
Vendor management: Manage DC vendor relationships within established SLAs and playbooks; review performance and drive improvements or changes as needed.
Financial control: Build and track project and portfolio budgets, burn, and margins; manage change orders to protect financial outcomes.
Risk, issue & change: Lead root-cause analyses and corrective action plans; escalate high-impact items with options and impact.
Client and stakeholder management: Lead portfolio-level planning and client reviews; explain results, risks, and next steps clearly; manage escalations and scope changes.
Team enablement: Coach DC PMs (P1-P2) and coordinators on delivery, QA, and DC-specific tools and workflows; support onboarding and skills growth (no formal line management required).
Compliance & security: Ensure data handling, consent, PII, and Info Sec policies are followed across all DC workstreams.
People Management: Gather feedback, provide training and coaching, foster team cohesion, conduct performance reviews, and support staffing and retention efforts.
Collaboration with Recruitment: Work closely with the recruiting team to manage DC hiring efforts by communicating role requirements, project pipeline, and candidate statuses. Review, evaluate, and select qualified candidates and decide on next steps (e.g., assessments, interviews, or further evaluation).

Job Details Under general direction of an Engineering Project Director, the Engineering Project Manager is responsible for one or more components of an overall project.

This role is suitable for an experienced Project Manager with an Engineering background (industrial Engineering is preferred). Projects relate to the design, build, and improvement of distribution facilities and processes. Assignments may span one or more projects that can range in size, complexity, and cross functional involvement.

Typical scope of management ranges from less than $1MM to greater than $20MM per project.

Works closely with Project Director to assist in the development of a project charter outlining project design and/or implementation requirements.
Assists in the preparation of capital expenditure requests for projects.
Manages assigned scope according to the project charter including vendor selection and vendor management from RFP through design, installation, and final invoicing.
Manages overall onsite build or installation coordination with internal and external partners.
Manages development and management of project budget
Project elements may include material handling equipment, warehouse, and business systems, building construction or modification and other equipment and services typically found within a distribution environment.
Assigned scope may include design, contractor coordination, testing, training, and start up activities.
May be assigned multiple areas of scope.

s.h: May be assigned overall responsibility for a project.
s.t:
Manages assigned team members in the execution of the assigned scope.
Manages and reports on project budget for assigned scope.
May issue or approve purchase orders according to company policy.
Develops, maintains, and reports on timelines for assigned scope.
Typically requires cross-functional coordination with other internal teams and vendors.
Generates timely and concise communication regarding project status and pending issues.
Supports in the development of supplier specifications and RFP’s, supports the contractual negotiations, and manages the execution of the plans outlined in the contracts.
Manages engagement with external consultants and other outsourced resources and vendors that perform work associated with the assigned project scope.
Coordinates activities with Project Director and other internal project teams to ensure alignment.
Willing to travel up to 50% of the time. Must be located near an airport.

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
Master’s Degree and/or PMP certification desired.

Experience managing automation or construction projects exceeding $5MM per project.
Experience leading cross-functional teams.

Die impulsarbeit gmbh entwickelt in Winterthur ein neues Förderprogramm für junge Frauen mit Fluchthintergrund.
Ziel ist die persönliche, gesellschaftliche und wirtschaftliche Emanzipation der Teilnehmerinnen. Die Frauen sollen ihre Ressourcen und Handlungsmöglichkeiten erweitern und schrittweise die Voraussetzungen schaffen, ihr Leben selbstbestimmt und möglichst unabhängig von staatlicher Unterstützung gestalten zu können.
Für den Aufbau und die fachliche Entwicklung des Programms suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 eine Projektleiterin (40 %). Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet.
Ein Programm mit Zeit für Entwicklung
Für die Aufbau- und Entwicklungsphase stehen substanzielle private Mittel zur Verfügung. Dadurch kann das Programm ohne kurzfristigen Finanzierungs-, Vermittlungs- oder Mengendruck entwickelt werden.
Unterschiedliche Ansätze können sorgfältig erprobt, ausgewertet und weiterentwickelt werden. Eine externe Wirkungsmessung begleitet das Programm und stellt sicher, dass Erkenntnisse systematisch in die kontinuierliche Qualitätsentwicklung einfliessen.
Ziel ist ein fachlich fundiertes, lernendes und langfristig anschlussfähiges Fördermodell. Die Zusammenarbeit mit Gemeinden, Kanton, Fachstellen und bestehenden Integrationsstrukturen ist ausdrücklich erwünscht.
Zwei Arbeitstage – zwei unterschiedliche Erfahrungsräume
Die 40%-Stelle verteilt sich grundsätzlich auf zwei Arbeitstage pro Woche.
1. Tag: Förderung, Arbeitsintegration und Fallarbeit
Die Teilnehmerinnen arbeiten in einem realen betrieblichen Umfeld und sammeln konkrete Arbeitserfahrungen. Die Projektleiterin begleitet diesen Prozess fachlich und individuell.

· arbeitsintegrative Begleitung

· individuelle Förderplanung

· Fallarbeit

· Erkennen und Aktivieren vorhandener Ressourcen

· Reflexion der Erfahrungen im Betrieb

· Entwicklung beruflicher und persönlicher Perspektiven

· Zusammenarbeit mit Betrieben, Fachstellen und weiteren Beteiligten

· Planung geeigneter nächster Entwicklungsschritte
2. Tag: Waldtag und individuelles Coaching
Der zweite Tag schafft bewusst einen anderen Rahmen. Ein Teil des Tages findet gemeinsam im Wald statt. Natur, Bewegung, gemeinsames Tun und Gespräche eröffnen andere Zugänge zu Ressourcen, Beziehungen und persönlichen Themen.
Ergänzend finden individuelle Coachings statt. Hier können persönliche Ziele, aktuelle Herausforderungen, Ressourcen und nächste Schritte vertieft bearbeitet werden.
Beide Tage gehören zusammen: konkrete Erfahrung und Arbeitsintegration auf der einen Seite, Reflexion, individuelle Entwicklung und Stabilisierung auf der anderen.
Fachlicher Hintergrund
Wir suchen eine Frau mit einem Abschluss in Sozialer Arbeit FH oder einem fundierten fachlichen Hintergrund in kunstbasierten, kunstpädagogischen oder kunsttherapeutischen Methoden.

s.h: Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrungen mit

· Lebensweltorientierung

· Capability- und Befähigungsansätzen

Erfahrung in der Projekt- und Aufbauarbeit ist von grossem Vorteil.
Von sehr grossem Vorteil sind Erfahrungen mit Förder- und Integrationsangeboten sowie in der direkten Arbeit mit Frauen mit Fluchthintergrund.
Gesucht wird eine eigenständige, reflektierte und entwicklungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die fachliche Qualität mit Freude an Aufbauarbeit verbindet.

s.h: Our mission: e liminating every barrier to mental health.
s.t:
Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.
Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.
As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.
Alma, a Spring Health Company, is on a mission to simplify access to high-quality, affordable mental health care. We do this by making it easy and financially rewarding for therapists to accept insurance and offer in-network care.

When a provider joins Alma, they gain access to a suite of tools that not only help them better run their business, but also grow it sustainably and develop as a provider. Alma is available in all 50 states, with over 20,000 therapists in our growing network. Anyone looking for a therapist can browse Alma’s free directory.

Alma has raised $220.5M in funding from Insight Partners, Optum Ventures, Tusk Venture Partners, Primary Venture Partners, First Round Capital, Sound Ventures, BoxGroup, Cigna Ventures, and Rainfall Ventures. Alma was also named one of Inc’s Best Workplaces in 2022 and 2023.
Candidate Interview Guide
Alma is looking for a Program Manager to join our Payer Success team within Operations. In this role, you'll be the central quarterback for our payer partnerships in steady-state operations – the person who holds the full picture across the end-to-end RCM lifecycle, from credentialing and rostering to claims adjudication to CX.

You won't be expected to solve every issue yourself, but you will be the one making sure nothing falls through the cracks: tracking open issues, mobilizing the right internal experts, and driving accountability across teams until problems are resolved.

You'll work closely across all teams at Alma, in particular within Operations and Business Development, to turn operational insights into action and improve outcomes across our payer portfolio. This is a full time, fully remote position on our team. Occasional travel may be required for team or company events/meetings.

Track open payer issues end-to-end, ensuring clear ownership, visibility, and accountability across cross-functional teams until resolution
Drive measurable business outcomes by improving RCM efficiency and effectiveness, with the ultimate goal of increasing revenue performance and delivering a better experience for Alma providers and their clients
Partner closely with internal operations teams to connect the dots across stakeholders, subteams, and workflows - surfacing interdependencies and ensuring issues move to resolution rather than stall
Serve as the primary operational point of contact for BD counterparts, triaging and coordinating new requirements surfaced by the payer and claims, roster, complaints, and escalation issues across assigned payers
Partner with the Business Development Team on payer calls to drive RCM discussions, align stakeholders, and move issues to resolution
Proactively monitor for new payer requirements and evolving payer mergers, and mobilize the right internal teams to implement changes before they become problems
Track and report on RCM performance by payer - surfacing trends, flagging risks, and ensuring the right teams are engaged to drive improvement

Portfolio RCM performance improvement (e.g., denial rate, reimbursement, AR days)
Portfolio payers meeting performance goals
On-time completion of payer initiatives/projects
Completion and maintenance of payer health assessments/business reviews
Stakeholder satisfaction (internal and payer partners)

Experienced in healthcare operations - you understand how insurance claims and payer relationships actually work
A strong cross-functional collaborator who can align people across teams without direct authority
Highly organized with a track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects from kickoff through launch
Comfortable in ambiguity - you can proactively identify what needs to happen next without waiting to be told
A clear communicator who can distill operational complexity for both internal partners and external payer contacts
Detail-oriented and data-driven, with the ability to monitor performance metrics and translate them into action

This position is being filled under DoD Modified Direct-Hire Auth (Certain DoD Personnel), PL 118-31, Sec 1250B(i)(2), 12/22/2023 As a IT PROJECT MANAGER at the GS-2210-13 some of your typical work assignments may include: Serving as Information Technology (IT) Project Manager (PM), center of expertise, lead government Point of Contact (POC), and Technical Representative for key IT projects.

Identifies and implements opportunities for improving project management efficiency and effectiveness. Responsible for implementing best practices to bring about the successful completion of JS specific Information Technology related project goals and objectives for assigned projects.

Ensure no changes to approved project schedules absent prior Government coordination and approval. Represents leadership to the JS, OSD, and external agencies.

Work with external agencies, services, and organizations, both government and commercial sector, to ensure the JS remains current with the state of commercial business technology practices while integrating the JS's IT requirements within DoD as well as Enterprise standards
You may qualify at the GS-13, if you fulfill the following qualifications: One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service: Overseeing and ensuring the achievement of all project goals and objectives while honoring the project constraints, which include project scope, time and budget Implementing best practices to bring about the successful completion of Information Technology related project goals and objectives for assigned projects; Guiding contracted enterprise solution efforts, including Technical Oversight, Schedule Management, Customer Coordination, reporting, and post-delivery assessment.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

In addition to meeting qualifications, your application package must reflect the applicable experience to meet the Individual Occupational Requirements for the 2210 series. https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/2200/information-technology-it-management-series-2210-alternative-a/ Experience must be IT related; the experience may be demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (for example, IT certification), as appropriate.

For all positions individuals must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Substitution of education may not be used in lieu of specialized experience for this grade level. All materials must be submitted by the closing date of the announcement.

# Projektleiter Anwendungstechnik 100% #
In dieser spannenden Funktion leiten Sie Projekte zur Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für Kunden aus den Bereichen Health Care sowie Industrie und Maschinenbau. Sie beraten Kunden und Vertriebsorganisationen in technischen Fragen wie Materialauswahl, Bauteil- und Werkstoffanalyse sowie Spritzgiessverarbeitung.

Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt liegt in der Durchführung von Versuchen und Abmusterungen auf modernen Anlagen im hauseigenen Spritzgiesstechnikum sowie direkt beim Kunden. Zudem erarbeiten Sie technische Grundlagen, führen Machbarkeitsanalysen durch und erstellen Kostenrechnungen.

Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams mit Forschung & Entwicklung, Produktion, Materialanalytik, Marketing und Verkauf tragen Sie massgeblich zur Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens bei.

Marktbeobachtungen zur Identifizierung neuer Trends und Technologien sowie das Halten von Fachvorträgen und internen Schulungen runden Ihr Aufgabengebiet ab.
Für diese verantwortungsvolle Position verfügen Sie über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Kunststofftechnik, Werkstofftechnik oder Maschinenbau. Berufserfahrung in der Spritzgusstechnologie und in der Auslegung technischer Kunststoffbauteile ist Voraussetzung.

Sie sind eine entscheidungsfreudige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Herausforderungen in den Bereichen Technologie und Projektmanagement aktiv sucht. Einsatzbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative und Flexibilität zählen ebenso zu Ihren Stärken wie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Es erwartet Sie ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Eigenverantwortung. Neben marktgerechter Entlöhnung, attraktiven Sozialleistungen und einer firmeneigenen Pensionskasse profitieren Sie von zusätzlichen Vorteilen wie einem modernen Personalrestaurant und kostenlosen Parkplätzen.
Wenn Sie Ihre Fachkompetenz in einem internationalen Umfeld einbringen und eine neue Herausforderung annehmen möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf mit Zeugnissen und Diplomen) per E-Mail an Herrn Jan Lucarelli (jan.lucarelli@evergreen-hr.ch).

* Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung von Investitions- und Infrastrukturprojekten im Verteilnetz
* Begleitung der Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Realisierung
* Planung und Projektierung von Hausanschlüssen, Trafostationen und Schaltanlagen
* Unterstützung interner Fachstellen und Projektverantwortlicher bei technischen und organisatorischen Fragestellungen
* Koordination verschiedener Anspruchsgruppen und Sicherstellung einer effizienten Projektabwicklung
* Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung von Netzplanung und Fachthemen
#### Das Anforderungsprofil ####
* Elektrotechnische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung (Elektrotechniker HF, Netzfachmann o.Ä.)

## Description de l'emploi ##
L'Unité organisation territoriale (UOT) de la Direction générale de la cohésion sociale (DGCS), contribue à la réflexion et au pilotage de l'organisation des prestations sociales sur le territoire cantonal.

Elle analyse les besoins des différentes régions, coordonne les acteurs concernés et accompagne la mise en œuvre et l'évolution des dispositifs sociaux, en veillant à leur cohérence et à leur accessibilité pour la population.

Elle a également pour mission d'assurer une vision cohérente transverse pour le parc immobilier subventionné par la DGCS qui comprend notamment l'hébergement médico-social (EMS, EPSM, ESE) et les ateliers à vocation productive, soit environ 400 bâtiments gérés par 250 partenaires.
Afin de mener un projet ambitieux visant à établir une stratégie pour la mise aux normes énergétiques et d'adaptation aux conséquences du réchauffement climatique du parc immobilier de la structure socio-sanitaire, l'Unité organisation territoriale (UOT) recherche **un·e Chef·fe de projet Plan climat.**
Pour de plus amples informations, veuillez consulter le cahier des charges en cliquant ici ou contacter Monsieur Mathieu Capcarrère, Conseiller stratégique, à l'adresse email: dgcs.recrutement@vd.ch
## Responsabilités ##
* Structurer et mettre en place de la phase 1 du projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois de 2ème génération œuvrant à faire un état des lieux du parc immobilier accueillant des populations vulnérables et subventionné par la DGCS.
* Piloter la phase 1 du projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois (EMPD 24 LEG 168) et en assurer l-avancement selon le calendrier prévu et l-enveloppe budgétaire dédiée.
* Conseiller, renseigner et appuyer les mandataires externes, les interlocuteur·trice·s internes, et les partenaires impliqués dans le projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois.
* Initier et piloter la phase 2 du projet DSAS-1 du plan climat vaudois en définissant et mettant en œuvre un ou plusieurs projets pilotes liés à la transition énergétique, à la durabilité et au climat, sur la base des résultats et analyses de la phase 1.
* Coconstruire les réflexions avec l-équipe UOT sur les questions de transition énergétique, durabilité et climat, et être activement partie prenante aux réflexions collectives de l-équipe et du service sur ces thématiques.

* Master EPF en architecture ou en ingénierie, ou titre jugé équivalent, exigé.
* Formation en gestion de projet souhaitée.
* Formation en analyse de parc immobilier exigée.
* Formation en expertise de la transition énergétique, un atout.
* Expérience professionnelle de 8 ans minimum dans la coordination d'équipe pluridisciplinaire et dans la gestion de projet.
* Solides connaissances des procédures de mises en concurrence selon les marchés publics.
* Bonnes compétences dans l'organisation d'octroi de mandats.
* Sens des responsabilités et éthique du service public.
* Capacité d'organisation, de gestion du temps, d'adaptation et de flexibilité.
* Écoute et communication.
* Bonne expression orale et esprit d'entraide et de collaboration.
* Vision globale et sens de la perspective.

**Aidez nos clients à prendre de meilleures décisions de transaction et à transformer les thèses transactionnelles en résultats mesurables**
Notre équipe suisse de premier plan en Transformation des Transactions et Intégration Post-Fusion conseille des clients suisses du secteur corporatif, du capital-investissement et du marché intermédiaire afin de générer et créer de la valeur tout au long du cycle de vie des fusions-acquisitions.

Nous aidons les clients à évaluer la performance opérationnelle avant la signature, à identifier et quantifier les opportunités de création de valeur, et à gérer les complexités des acquisitions, cessions et scissions.

Chez Deloitte, nous collaborons étroitement avec nos collègues des services transactionnels, des évaluations et de la finance d'entreprise pour garantir une approche fluide et axée sur la valeur des transactions.
**Comment vous ferez la différence**
Vous travaillerez avec des équipes de direction d-entreprises, des investisseurs en capital-investissement et des professionnels des fusions-acquisitions pour identifier et réaliser la valeur issue des transactions M&A. Vous aiderez à façonner la réflexion stratégique, à traiter les enjeux critiques de performance et à mobiliser l-ensemble des compétences de Deloitte pour maximiser la valeur des transactions.
En tant que membre d-une équipe dédiée de spécialistes M&A, vous fournirez des conseils en due diligence opérationnelle en reliant la performance financière, les capacités opérationnelles et l-ambition stratégique. Votre travail portera sur la croissance des revenus et la réduction des coûts à travers le coût des marchandises vendues (COGS) et les frais généraux, administratifs et commerciaux (SG&A), que ce soit par des opportunités d-amélioration autonome ou des synergies transactionnelles.
**Votre rôle et responsabilités**
* Diriger la livraison quotidienne des missions ou volets de création de valeur M&A et de due diligence pré-transaction, en collaborant avec les interlocuteurs clients sur le contenu, les conclusions et les priorités ;
* Diriger et travailler au sein d-équipes projets pour réaliser des due diligences, des analyses opérationnelles et des bases financières, et assurer la qualité des analyses et livrables produits ;
* Aider les clients corporatifs et en capital-investissement à comprendre les capacités opérationnelles des cibles potentielles et des sociétés du portefeuille existant ;
* Soutenir les clients corporatifs et en capital-investissement dans l-évaluation des synergies potentielles de fusion, l-impact et les complexités des scissions sur les organisations vendeuses et cibles, ainsi que le potentiel d-amélioration autonome des performances des rachats et cessions d-entreprises ;
* Structurer et conduire des entretiens clients pour identifier les complexités opérationnelles et les opportunités de création de valeur, impliquant souvent des parties prenantes senior à travers l-organisation ;
* Synthétiser rapidement des informations qualitatives et quantitatives issues de sources diverses en hypothèses de création de valeur claires, fondées sur des preuves, et en un récit convaincant que les clients peuvent facilement comprendre ;
* Appliquer une approche pragmatique 80/20 pour concentrer les livrables sur les enjeux les plus importants pour la transaction et la thèse d-investissement ;
* Fournir des conseils pratiques de création de valeur opérationnelle appuyés par des preuves issues d-entretiens, d-analyses de données, de bases financières et de benchmarks externes ;
* Gérer la portée, les priorités, les délais, les budgets, les risques et la qualité des missions, en collaboration étroite avec les associés, directeurs et managers seniors ;
* Construire des relations de confiance avec les dirigeants d-entreprise, les investisseurs en capital-investissement, les professionnels M&A et les responsables fonctionnels ;
* Soutenir le développement commercial par la préparation de propositions, présentations et documents clients, et contribuer au développement des relations clients ; et
* Identifier, concevoir et diriger des initiatives de développement de la pratique axées sur la création de valeur M&A et la due diligence pré-transaction.
**Ce que nous recherchons**
* Un diplôme de Bachelor ou Master en commerce, économie, finance, ingénierie ou autre discipline pertinente ;
* Au moins cinq ans d-expérience professionnelle pertinente en M&A, avec un accent particulier sur la due diligence commerciale ou opérationnelle au sein d-un cabinet Big Four, d-un cabinet de conseil en stratégie ou d-un conseiller spécialisé en restructuration et redressement ;
* Une expérience approfondie en due diligence opérationnelle, ainsi qu-en identification, suivi et réalisation de synergies ; diagnostics de séparation et calculs autonomes ; diagnostics de performance autonome ;
* Idéalement, une expérience démontrée également en due diligence commerciale, planification d-entreprise, revue de plans d-affaires et croissance des revenus ;
* Une connaissance démontrée des processus de due diligence et des exigences documentaires dans un environnement de conseil ;
* Une expérience et une connaissance dans une ou plusieurs des industries suivantes : Énergie, Ressources & Industriels ; Consommation ; Sciences de la vie & Santé ; ou Technologie, Médias & Télécommunications ;
* Excellentes compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de décomposer des enjeux complexes, d-identifier les causes profondes et de recommander des solutions actionnables ; et
* Une maîtrise professionnelle complète de l-anglais ; la maîtrise de l-allemand, idéalement incluant l-allemand suisse, est fortement souhaitée.
**Rejoindre notre équipe**
Vous ferez partie d-une équipe amicale, diversifiée et très motivée. Nous vous aiderons à vous développer tant personnellement que professionnellement grâce à l-apprentissage sur le terrain, au mentorat et à des formations de haute qualité, ainsi qu-en travaillant avec des pairs à travers des portefeuilles d-offres diversifiés.

Chez Deloitte, nous sommes engagés dans une forte culture de feedback, afin d-exposer nos talents à un environnement professionnel large et global et à un apprentissage continu.

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.
We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

Kraken Customer
What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.
Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.
We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like.

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.
The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs.
The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients.

You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)
You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues
Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform
Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally.
Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.
Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features
Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.
This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.
We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.
You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change.
You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client.
We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

Le poste s'inscrit directement dans cette phase de développement et permettra au futur collaborateur de jouer un rôle central dans la réussite de plusieurs opérations importantes à Genève.

En tant que Chef de Projet, vous prenez la responsabilité opérationnelle de deux chantiers situés à Genève et assurez leur bonne exécution jusqu'à la livraison.

* Piloter simultanément deux chantiers et assurer leur avancement dans le respect des délais, des coûts et des standards de qualité.

Nous recherchons un professionnel de la construction disposant d'une expérience confirmée en chefferie de projets, idéalement acquise sur des projets de construction ou de rénovation d'envergure.

Coordinate and lead multidisciplinary teams across programme management, systems engineering, spacecraft engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, quality and business functions.

Master’s degree in aerospace engineering.

Proven experience leading the end-to-end development of satellites, orbiters, spacecraft or complex space systems.
